title: Extra Characters in a String
summary: Given a string s and a dictionary of words, find the minimum number of extra characters in s that cannot be part of any substring found in the dictionary when optimally breaking s.
statement: Given a string s and a dictionary of words, find the minimum number of extra characters in s that cannot be part of any substring found in the dictionary when optimally breaking s.
constraints: Split any collection of nonoverlapping substrings from s whose exact values appear in dictionary.
Characters not covered by chosen dictionary words are extra.
Return the minimum possible number of extra characters.
hints: Let dp[i] be the minimum extras in the first i characters.
Default to treating s[i-1] as one extra character.
For every earlier boundary j whose substring s[j:i] is a dictionary word, minimize with dp[j].
Every optimal segmentation ends either in one extra character or one complete dictionary word, so the recurrence exhausts its final choice.
editorial: Every optimal segmentation ends either in one extra character or one complete dictionary word, so the recurrence exhausts its final choice.

tests.explanation: Choose leet and code, leaving only s as one extra character.
Using hello and world leaves the three-character prefix say extra.
